items.title: 北極冷空氣恐提前南下 歐洲天然氣庫存再添壓力
items.title_en: Arctic Cold Air May Move South Earlier, Adding Pressure to Europe’s Gas Inventories
paras: 今年北極冷空氣可能比往年更早南下，令庫存已處多年低點的歐洲天然氣市場再添變數，歐洲距離更深一輪能源危機或許只差幾次寒潮。
歐洲中期天氣預報中心（ECMWF）的預報顯示，北極極渦可能提前受到擾動，進而將冷空氣推向西北歐。極渦是冬季盤踞在北極上空的冷空氣團，一旦受到擾動而減弱或變形，冷空氣就會向南擴散。
此前已有媒體報導，北極上空高層大氣今年可能出現有記錄以來最早的一次急劇升溫。這種升溫可能導致極渦分裂，北極冷空氣可能在數周內侵襲美國北部和歐洲部分地區。
據英國氣象局介紹，2018年初席捲英國的「東方野獸」寒潮，就與這類高空急劇升溫有關。
對於儲氣緩衝本已偏薄的歐洲而言，這一氣象變化可能迅速轉化為能源壓力。據能源研究機構測算，若12月2日至8日歐洲平均氣溫較過去10年同期常年水準低攝氏5度，西北歐以及義大利、西班牙、奧地利的供暖用氣需求將增加約11億立方公尺。
如果這部分需求全部依靠庫存滿足，明年3月底歐洲儲氣率將從正常天氣下的約17%降至15.5%左右，僅比該機構估算的最低水準高出約0.5個百分點。一旦跌破最低水平，意味著商業庫存基本耗盡，歐洲將開始動用部分國家的戰略儲備天然氣。
值得注意的是，這一周潛在寒潮帶來的額外消耗，已足以抹平10月暖冬換來的額外積累。10月氣溫偏暖，供暖用氣減少，歐洲得以繼續往儲氣庫裡補充天然氣，當月新增儲氣量較2021年至2025年同期均值多出約10億立方公尺。
即便如此，歐洲入冬時的天然氣庫存仍僅約容量的74%，處於2022年能源危機以來同期最低。
國際能源署（IEA）3日也在最新報告中警告，歐洲天然氣庫存偏低，一旦遭遇供應中斷將難以招架，明年3月下旬庫存可能降至10%以下。
paras_en: This year the Arctic cold air may move south earlier than in previous years, adding a new variable to Europe’s natural‑gas market, which has been at multi‑year lows, and bringing the continent a few cold snaps away from a deeper energy crisis.

The European Centre for Medium‑Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) predicts that the Arctic polar vortex could be disturbed earlier than usual, pushing cold air toward north‑west Europe. The polar vortex is a mass of cold air that sits over the Arctic in winter; if it is weakened or deformed by a disturbance, the cold air spreads southward.

Earlier media reports have noted that the upper atmosphere over the Arctic could experience the earliest recorded rapid warming this year. Such warming could cause the polar vortex to split, allowing Arctic cold air to invade parts of the United States and Europe within a few weeks.
According to the UK Met Office, the “Beast from the East” cold spell that swept Britain in early 2018 was linked to this type of rapid upper‑air warming.

For Europe, whose gas‑storage buffers are already thin, this weather shift could quickly turn into energy pressure. Energy‑research institutes estimate that if the average temperature across Europe from Dec 2‑8 is 5 °C below the ten‑year historical average, heating‑gas demand in north‑west Europe, Italy, Spain and Austria would rise by roughly 1.1 billion cubic metres.

If that extra demand had to be met entirely from inventories, Europe’s storage rate would fall from about 17 % under normal weather to roughly 15.5 % by the end of March next year – only about 0.5 percentage points above the institute’s estimated minimum level. Falling below that threshold would mean commercial stocks are essentially exhausted and Europe would have to tap strategic gas reserves of some member states.

It is worth noting that the additional consumption from the potential cold snap this week is already enough to erase the extra gas accumulation achieved during the warm October. The milder October reduced heating demand, allowing Europe to keep filling storage, and the net addition that month was about 1 billion cubic metres more than the average for the same period in 2021‑2025.
Nevertheless, Europe’s gas inventories at the start of winter remain only about 74 % of capacity, the lowest level for the same period since the 2022 energy crisis.

The International Energy Agency (IEA) warned on the 3rd that Europe’s gas stocks are low and would struggle to cope with supply disruptions, with inventories potentially falling below 10 % by late March next year.

items.title: 選後資金轉向！蘋果單日大漲逾5% 遠離AI資本支出戰場成科技股避風港
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周三(4日)股價大漲逾5%，創下一年多來最佳單日表現，進一步鞏固這家iPhone製造商作為科技投資人避風港的地位，顯示在人工智慧(AI)基礎設施投資受到期中選舉結果衝擊之後，投資人正轉向相對不受AI資本支出影響的科技巨頭。
蘋果周三終場上漲5.3%，收在每股349.51美元，是2025年5月以來最大單日漲幅。就在一周前，蘋果才於10月29日以348.91美元創下前一波歷史新高。
截至周三收盤，蘋果市值達5.08兆美元，進一步拉開與輝達(NVDA-US)的差距。輝達市值當日收盤為4.82兆美元。

AI基礎設施股低迷 蘋果成科技避風港

Equity Armor Investments執行長Luke Rahbari表示，蘋果股價飆升主要受到整體市場環境帶動，而非本身出現特定利多。民主黨在期中選舉大勝後，那斯達克綜合指數及其他主要指數周三同步上漲，顯示華爾街認為分裂政府可能減少監管政策意外，並抑制美國公債殖利率。
Rahbari認為，選舉結果也凸顯地方政府與居民反對資料中心的聲浪升高，這間接為蘋果帶來助力。
Rahbari說：「蘋果的獲利不仰賴興建資料中心。如果AI建設放緩，甚至可能緩解記憶體晶片成本上升對蘋果利潤率造成的壓力，不過蘋果目前仍預期記憶體價格將持續上漲。」
相較於其他科技巨頭投入數千億美元興建資料中心與AI基礎設施，蘋果一直控制支出，選擇與Google Gemini建立AI合作關係，並延續以庫藏股回購為核心的策略。這套紀律嚴謹的策略過去曾讓蘋果飽受批評，但如今在這種市場環境下反而派上用場。
不過，仰賴AI基礎設施持續擴建的硬體類股並未跟上漲勢，iShares半導體ETF(SOXX-US)周三下跌逾3%，被稱為「新興雲端服務商」(neoclouds)的AI雲端業者如CoreWeave(CRWV-US)股價下跌10%，晶片巨頭輝達也下跌3%。
超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)如微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Meta(META-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則逆勢收高，分析師指出，若資料中心供給受限，反而有利它們漲價。

投資人轉向大型股避險 但蘋果估值不便宜

Bahnsen Group投資長David Bahnsen表示，蘋果股價目前正收復周一公布財報後的跌幅。
他形容，蘋果「與其說是科技股，不如說更像消費股」。不過，蘋果不屬於超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)，反而成為一大優勢。
過去一個月以來，亞馬遜、Alphabet、Meta及微軟這些科技巨頭股價受到沉重壓力，投資人愈來愈擔心，企業投入AI基礎設施的數千億美元究竟能否帶來相應回報。
Bahnsen說：「投資人正在尋找大型科技股中的避風港，目前蘋果是這些股票之外的一個不錯選擇。」
他補充說：「蘋果有自己的步調。」但這種防禦性並不便宜，過去12個月本益比接近40倍，也就是投資人為公司每1美元獲利所支付的股價。
事實上，過去一年來，蘋果的估值已與整體科技產業大幅分歧。Jefferies交易部門分析師Jeffrey Favuzza上周指出，蘋果目前股價相當於未來預估獲利的35.8倍，接近多年高點。相較之下，那斯達克指數的預估本益比為20.3倍，過去12個月已大幅下滑。

items.title: 超市「冷櫃變暖箱」只是開始？英國警告：更多攻擊恐在路上
items.title_en: Supermarket “Freezer Turns Into Heater” Just the Start? UK Warns More Attacks Likely Ahead
paras: 英國網路安全負責人周二（3日）表示，歐洲多地超市冷凍櫃遭駭客攻擊的事件只是一記早期警鐘，老舊技術跟不上駭客進化，類似事件恐怕會愈發頻繁。
瑞典、比利時、法國等多國超市的冷櫃與冰櫃周一相繼遭遇網路攻擊。這些攻擊撕開了老舊IT系統的防線漏洞，令冷凍櫃一夜變「加熱櫃」，致使大量食品變質報廢，門市損失慘重。
英國國家網路安全中心主任理查德·霍恩表示，此次事件可以說還僅僅只是冰山一角。
「眼下潛伏著大量漏洞，從某種角度來說，它們就像在被動排隊等待被利用，」霍恩說道，「我們在短期內面臨的最嚴峻威脅，正是這類攻擊事件爆發式增長。」
英國政府通訊總部在年度報告中指出，預計未來幾年AI將增強駭客的能力。英國國家網路安全中心官員表示，在冷櫃攻擊事件中，駭客可能都不需要使用先進AI，因為這些攻擊針對的是舊技術已知漏洞。
霍恩表示，AI將使發現此類舊漏洞變得越來越容易，並能大規模加以利用。
「我們必須清醒認識到這絕非AI開創了什麼全新攻擊手法，而是那些被放任太久脆弱點，如今以過去難以想像的規模被機器式挖掘和放大利用。」霍恩說道。
paras_en: UK cyber‑security chief said on Tuesday (the 3rd) that the recent hacks of supermarket freezers across Europe are only an early warning sign; outdated technology can’t keep up with evolving hackers, and similar incidents are likely to become more frequent.

Freezers and chillers in supermarkets in Sweden, Belgium, France and other countries were hit by cyber‑attacks on Monday. The attacks exploited gaps in legacy IT systems, turning freezers into “heating units” overnight, causing massive food spoilage and heavy losses for retailers.
Richard Horn, director of the UK National Cyber Security Centre, said the incidents are just the tip of the iceberg.

“There are a huge number of vulnerabilities lying in wait, and in a sense they’re passively queuing to be exploited,” Horn said. “The most severe threat we face in the short term is the explosive growth of this type of attack.”

The UK Government Communications Headquarters noted in its annual report that AI is expected to boost hackers’ capabilities in the coming years. NCSC officials said that in the freezer attacks, hackers likely didn’t need advanced AI because they were exploiting known flaws in old technology.
Horn said AI will make it increasingly easy to discover such legacy vulnerabilities and to weaponise them at scale.

“We must recognise that this is not AI inventing brand‑new attack methods, but rather long‑neglected weak points now being mined and amplified by machines on a scale previously unimaginable,” Horn warned.

items.title: 共和黨敗選後首波政治清算！赫格塞斯成美伊戰爭「替罪羔羊」 CNN：最快下周啟動彈劾投票
items.title_en: First Wave of Political Payback After GOP Election Loss! Hegseth Becomes the “Scapegoat” of the US‑Iran War, CNN: Impeachment Vote Could Start as Early as Next Week
paras: 美國期中選舉民主黨橫掃參眾兩院，共和黨內迅速掀起問責風暴，矛頭直指國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)，最新傳出多位共和黨議員與盟友將敗選歸咎於伊朗戰爭，認為赫格塞斯是推動開戰的關鍵人物，卻未規劃退場機制與政治後果管理。
《CNN》報導，肯塔基州共和黨籍眾議員Thomas Massie在眾議院復會後，將發起彈劾赫格塞思的投票，指控其未經國會授權對伊朗採取敵對行動、濫用職權。共和黨消息人士預期表決可過關，這將是現屆國會選後首波政治清算。
美國總統川普週三(4日)則公開力挺赫格塞斯，稱其「幹得非常好」、無意撤換，但顧問私下坦言，戰爭拖累選情下，「總得有人承擔責任，而不會是總統」。
美國副總統萬斯亦鬆口質疑伊朗戰事是否值得，共和黨參議員Thom Tillis直言赫格塞斯終將面臨「清算」，其與國會交惡更恐拖累1.5兆美元國防支出案。
民主黨已承諾展開廣泛調查，涵蓋伊朗軍事行動決策、高階將領「清洗」、烏克蘭政策，以及拉美海域疑似涉戰爭罪的反毒空襲。
另有傳聞稱，赫格塞斯可能轉任田納西州參議員，接替明年出任州長的Marsha Blackburn遺缺，川普僅稱「沒聽說過這種說法」。
分析指出，2006年小布希以倫斯斐為伊拉克戰爭背書的下課劇本正被重提。赫格塞思雖暫保官位，卻同時承受白宮止損、黨內倒戈、國會調查三重壓力，這場「替罪羔羊」博弈，將決定川普政府剩餘任期的國防路線與戰爭責任歸屬。
paras_en: The Democrats swept both houses of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, prompting an immediate accountability storm within the Republican Party that zeroes in on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Multiple GOP lawmakers and allies are blaming the loss on the war with Iran, arguing that Hegseth was the key figure who pushed the country into conflict without a clear exit strategy or political fallout management plan.

CNN reports that Republican Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky will launch an impeachment vote against Hegseth after the House reconvenes, accusing him of taking hostile action against Iran without congressional authorization and abusing his authority. Republican sources expect the vote to pass, marking the first wave of political payback in the current Congress after the election.

President Donald Trump publicly backed Hegseth on Wednesday (the 4th), calling his performance “very good” and saying there is no intention to replace him. However, advisers privately admitted that the war is hurting the administration’s electoral prospects and that “someone has to take responsibility, and it won’t be the president.”

Vice President Kamala Harris also hinted that the Iran war may not be worth it, while Republican Senator Thom Tillis bluntly said Hegseth will eventually face “payback,” warning that his clash with Congress could jeopardize a $1.5 trillion defense spending bill.

Democrats have pledged a broad investigation covering the decision‑making behind Iran’s military actions, a “purge” of senior officers, Ukraine policy, and alleged war‑crime‑related anti‑drug airstrikes in Latin American waters.

There are rumors that Hegseth could be appointed to the U.S. Senate from Tennessee to fill the seat that will be vacated by Governor‑elect Marsha Blackburn next year; Trump said he “has never heard of such a suggestion.”

Analysts note that the script used in 2006 when George W. Bush backed the Iraq war with the Lunsford‑type resignation is being revisited. While Hegseth currently retains his post, he is simultaneously under pressure from the White House to cut losses, from his party’s internal revolt, and from congressional investigations. This “scapegoat” showdown will determine the defense trajectory and war‑responsibility allocation for the remainder of the Trump administration’s term.

items.title: 法國血液機構冷藏設施遭網攻 冷庫溫度被調至極高
items.title_en: France Blood Agency's Cold Storage Facilities Hit by Cyberattack, Freezer Temperatures Set to Extremely High
paras: 法國血液機構（EFS）4日（周三）證實，三處儲存重要血液製品的冷庫遭網攻，冷庫溫度被調至「極高」，所幸警報系統及時發出警告，技術人員得以在血液製品受損前採取干預措施。
此次攻擊發生在當地時間1日晚至2日凌晨。與此同時，歐洲近十個國家的超市冰箱和冷凍設備溫度異常飆升，部分設備溫度甚至達到攝氏50度，造成價值數百萬歐元食品損失。
EFS是法國公共輸血服務機構，負責採集、檢測、製備和配送血液、血漿及血小板等製品，為全法1,900多家醫院提供服務。
EFS表示，該機構本身並非駭客的直接攻擊目標，遭到攻擊的是承包商旗下冷庫。
受影響冷庫中儲存的血液製品，包括用於輸血和藥品生產的袋裝血漿，均已轉移至其他地點。
該機構稱，技術團隊正與法國國家資訊系統安全局及衛生部保持聯繫，並加強對所有設備運行情況的監測。
上個月法國曾發生一系列類似網路攻擊，駭客控制了700家超市製冷設備。一名消息人士4日透露，法國互助信貸銀行集團旗下Crédit Mutuel Arkéa也遭駭客入侵，電腦系統受到攻擊，造成超過1億美元損失。
paras_en: France's blood agency (EFS) confirmed on Wednesday the 4th that three cold storage units holding critical blood products were targeted by a cyberattack, with temperatures raised to "extremely high". Fortunately, the alarm system triggered in time, allowing technicians to intervene before the blood products were damaged.

The attack occurred from the evening of the 1st to the early hours of the 2nd local time. At the same time, supermarket refrigerators and freezers in nearly ten European countries experienced abnormal temperature spikes, some reaching 50°C, resulting in food losses worth millions of euros.
EFS is France's public blood service, responsible for collecting, testing, preparing and distributing blood, plasma and platelet products, serving more than 1,900 hospitals nationwide.
EFS said the agency itself was not the direct target of the hackers; the compromised facilities were cold storage units operated by a contractor.
The affected freezers stored blood products, including bagged plasma used for transfusions and drug manufacturing, all of which have been relocated to other sites.
The agency stated its technical team is in contact with the French National Cybersecurity Agency and the Health Ministry, and is intensifying monitoring of all equipment operations.

Last month France experienced a series of similar cyberattacks, with hackers taking control of refrigeration equipment in 700 supermarkets. A source told on the 4th that Crédit Mutuel Arkéa, part of the French mutual credit bank group, was also breached, its computer systems attacked, causing losses exceeding $100 million.

items.title: 期中選舉變天效應！微軟、亞馬遜市值合計單日暴增4240億美元 資料中心若受限反成利多？
items.title_en: Midterm Election Upset Boosts Microsoft and Amazon by $424 B in One Day; Data Center Restrictions May Actually Help?
paras: 民主黨在美國期中選舉拿下眾議院與參議院、取得重大勝利之後，多家科技巨頭周三(4日)股價大幅上漲，例如亞馬遜(Amazon)與微軟(MSFT-US)，單日市值合計暴增4240億美元。但與人工智慧(AI)相關個股、特別是與川普顧問馬斯克以及AI資料中心建設相關的股票，則應聲下跌。
周三上漲的許多科技股屬於所謂的「超大規模雲端服務商」(hyperscalers)，也就是規模最大的雲端服務業者。這些企業不僅投入龐大資本支出(capex)，也擁有強勁的自由現金流，且在興建AI資料中心方面具備最豐富的經驗與能力。
亞馬遜周三股價收漲6.1%，微軟上漲6.7%。根據道瓊市場數據，兩家公司當天市值合計增加4240億美元，其中亞馬遜增加1660億美元，微軟增加2590億美元。
同為雲端服務商的Alphabet(GOOGL-US)周三收漲3.2%，Meta Platforms(META-US)也收紅，上漲1.4%。
另一方面，特斯拉(TSLA-US)股價下跌2%，SpaceX下跌3%。為多數AI資料中心計畫供應晶片的輝達(NVDA-US)則小跌逾1%。規模較小、通常稱為「新興雲端服務商」(neoclouds)的AI雲端業者如CoreWeave(CRWV-US)股價下跌10%。
記憶體股方面，美光(MU-US)與SanDisk(SNDK-US)週三跌幅均超過 7%，SK海力士ADR(SKHY-US)也重挫逾 5%。

超大雲端服務商為何上漲？

周二晚間選舉結果陸續出爐時，部分觀察人士一開始認為，這對押注興建大型AI資料中心的科技巨頭而言可能是壞消息。周二共有41項地方公投提案，內容涵蓋限制AI資料中心或為其開發掃除障礙，選民在其中40項投票中反對資料中心。CNBC選民調查顯示，56%的選民表示，資料中心是影響其投票決定的重要或關鍵因素。
不過，專家指出幾項因素可能的原因。首先，民主黨贏得國會控制權，並拿下幾個關鍵州的州長席次後，科技業部分領域的投資人正擔心資料中心可能面臨新的開發限制，但微軟與亞馬遜的投資人或許認為，資料中心開發速度放緩未必是壞事。
德州州長當選人希諾霍薩(Gina Hinojosa)競選期間承諾，在州政府制定資料中心建設相關規範前，將立即暫停資料中心興建。現任共和黨籍州長艾伯特(Greg Abbott)則已於9月暫停核發資料中心許可，但監督團體FracTracker與公共公民組織(Public Citizen)的一份報告發現，該命令發布後，許可核發作業仍持續進行。

資料中心供給受限 反而有利雲端巨頭漲價

Gabelli Funds投資組合經理人John Belton表示，市場預期算力將持續供不應求，「未來資料中心容量若受到任何額外限制」，都可能讓亞馬遜與微軟等既有雲端服務業者得以調漲價格。
他補充，這可能改善企業利潤率，進而提高獲利能力。
另一種看法是，在新的政策環境下，微軟與亞馬遜可能放慢資料中心支出。考量AI投資已逐漸侵蝕這些企業創造的現金，投資人或許樂見資本支出降溫。

選後不確定性消退 帶動空頭回補

Tigress Financial Partners分析師Ivan Feinseth指出，微軟與亞馬遜受惠於「選後鬆一口氣、政策不確定性降低、投資人重新燃起對AI與雲端運算的熱情，以及大規模空頭回補」等因素。
他指出，投資人原本正為選後股市可能下跌預作準備，如今則開始「解除」防禦性部位。
Feinseth認為，這次選舉是亞馬遜與微軟等科技股短期內的催化因素，但持續的AI需求與基礎設施支出等「更具持續性的驅動因素」，才是長期推動這些股票走勢的關鍵。
paras_en: After the Democrats secured major victories in both the House and Senate in the U.S. midterm elections, several tech giants saw their stocks jump sharply on Wednesday (the 4th), with Amazon and Microsoft together adding $424 billion in market value in a single day. However, AI‑related stocks, especially those tied to Trump adviser Elon Musk and AI data‑center construction, fell in response.

Many of the tech stocks that rose on Wednesday belong to the so‑called “hyperscalers,” the largest cloud service providers. These firms not only pour massive capital expenditures into growth but also generate strong free cash flow and have the deepest experience and capability in building AI data centers.

Amazon closed up 6.1% on Wednesday, while Microsoft rose 6.7%. According to Dow Jones market data, the two companies’ combined market‑value increase that day was $424 billion, with Amazon adding $166 billion and Microsoft $259 billion.
Fellow cloud provider Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) gained 3.2% on Wednesday, and Meta Platforms (META‑US) also finished in the green, up 1.4%.

On the other hand, Tesla (TSLA‑US) fell 2% and SpaceX slipped 3%. Nvidia (NVDA‑US), a major chip supplier for most AI data‑center projects, dipped just over 1%. Smaller “neocloud” AI cloud players such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) saw their shares drop 10%.
In the memory‑chip sector, Micron (MU‑US) and SanDisk (SNDK‑US) each fell more than 7% on Wednesday, while SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) slumped over 5%.

Why did the hyperscalers rise? When election results started coming in on Tuesday night, some observers initially thought the outcome could be bad news for tech giants betting on large AI data‑center builds. Tuesday saw 41 local ballot measures covering either restrictions on AI data centers or the removal of obstacles to their development, and voters rejected data‑center proposals in 40 of those 41 votes. A CNBC poll showed 56% of voters said data‑center issues were an important or decisive factor in how they voted.

Experts point to several possible reasons. First, with Democrats gaining control of Congress and winning key governorships, investors in certain tech sectors worry that data‑center development could face new limits, but Microsoft and Amazon investors may view a slowdown in data‑center construction as not necessarily negative.

Gina Hinojosa, the winning Democratic candidate for Texas governor, pledged during her campaign to halt any data‑center construction until the state adopts related regulations. The incumbent Republican governor, Greg Abbott, already paused the issuance of data‑center permits in September, but a report by watchdog FracTracker and Public Citizen found that permit processing continued after the order was issued.

Limited data‑center supply could actually benefit cloud giants by allowing price hikes. John Belton, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds, said the market expects computing power to remain in short supply, and “any additional restriction on data‑center capacity in the future” could let incumbents like Amazon and Microsoft raise prices.
He added that such a scenario could improve corporate profit margins and boost earnings potential.

Another view is that under the new policy environment, Microsoft and Amazon may slow their data‑center spending. As AI investment increasingly eats into the cash these companies generate, investors might welcome a cooling of capital expenditures.

Post‑election uncertainty fading fuels short covering. Ivan Feinseth, analyst at Tigress Financial Partners, noted that Microsoft and Amazon benefited from “post‑election relief, reduced policy uncertainty, renewed investor enthusiasm for AI and cloud computing, and large‑scale short covering.”
He explained that investors had been positioning defensively in anticipation of a post‑election market decline, but are now beginning to unwind those defensive positions.

Feinseth believes the election acted as a short‑term catalyst for tech stocks like Amazon and Microsoft, but that sustained AI demand and ongoing infrastructure spending – “more durable drivers” – will be the key long‑term forces shaping these stocks’ trajectories.

items.title_en: Democratic Party Victory Acts as a Rally Catalyst! Market Bets AI‑Spending Slowdown Boosts Cash Flow—All Five Tech Giants Rise, Market‑Cap Surges $1 Trillion in a Day
paras: 美國期中選舉結果牽動美國科技股走勢，五大科技巨頭週三(4日)股價集體跳漲，投資人押注民主黨掌控國會後，將放緩正瘋狂吞噬自由現金流的AI巨額支出，亞馬遜盤中一度大漲8.3%，微軟漲7%，Alphabet漲5.9%，Meta漲3.6%；連同避開AI重資產投入、一度漲逾6%的蘋果，五家巨頭合計市值料增近1兆美元。
民主黨在週二(3日)期中選舉中拿下參眾兩院多數，翻轉南卡羅來納、德州、堪薩斯等傳統共和黨票倉，並擴大州級執政版圖，其競選核心主張之一，正是審查AI資料中心大規模建設、強化地方監管。
Dakota Wealth資深投組經理人Robert Pavlik說，「市場反應就像在慶祝AI建設週期結束」，並稱若超大规模雲端業者不再砸千億建算力，自由現金流就有望由負轉正。
瑞銀策略報告亦引述出口民調指出，選民強烈反對社區新建資料中心，「藍色浪潮」最大衝擊將來自各州加強監管。
事實上，科技七巨頭近期持續承壓。自10月21日Meta揭開雲端財報季以來，彭博七巨頭指數已下跌5.9%，今年迄今漲幅減少至4.1%，落後標普500與那斯達克100。亞馬遜、Alphabet、Meta自由現金流均已轉負，資本支出靠發債與股權融資支撐。
分析師認為，週三行情雖帶投機色彩，卻點出關鍵轉變，也就是市場對自由現金流的敏感度已壓過AI敘事。雲端巨頭原本身處兩難，如今選舉像一份禮物，剎車由政府來踩。
paras_en: The results of the U.S. midterm elections are influencing the direction of American tech stocks. On Wednesday (the 4th), the shares of the five major tech giants all jumped, as investors bet that a Democratic‑controlled Congress will slow the massive AI spending that has been devouring free cash flow. Amazon surged as much as 8.3% intraday, Microsoft rose 7%, Alphabet 5.9%, Meta 3.6%, and even Apple—avoiding heavy AI‑related capital outlays—spiked more than 6%. Together, the five firms are expected to add nearly $1 trillion to their combined market value.

The Democrats captured majorities in both the House and Senate on Tuesday (the 3rd), flipping traditional Republican strongholds such as South Carolina, Texas and Kansas and expanding their state‑level governing footprint. One of their core campaign pledges is to scrutinize the large‑scale construction of AI data centers and tighten local regulation.

Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth, said, “The market’s reaction is like a celebration that the AI‑building cycle is ending,” adding that if the ultra‑large cloud providers stop pouring hundreds of billions into compute capacity, free cash flow could swing from negative to positive.

A UBS strategy report, citing an export poll, also noted that voters are strongly opposed to new community data centers, and that the biggest impact of the “blue wave” will come from tighter regulation at the state level.

In fact, the seven major tech firms have been under pressure lately. Since Meta kicked off the cloud earnings season on October 21, Bloomberg’s seven‑giant index has fallen 5.9%, and its year‑to‑date gain has shrunk to 4.1%, lagging both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq‑100. Amazon, Alphabet and Meta have all turned negative on free cash flow, with capital expenditures now being funded by debt and equity issuance.

Analysts say Wednesday’s market move, while speculative, highlights a key shift: sensitivity to free cash flow now outweighs the AI narrative. Cloud giants, previously caught in a dilemma, now see the election as a gift—braking power coming from the government.

1.據《CNBC》4日報導，民主黨在美國期中選舉拿下國會兩院，加上川普表態接受結果，緩解籠罩華爾街的政治不確定性，美股期貨從隔夜大跌轉為強勁上揚，道瓊期貨大漲逾800點。不過，市場擔憂資料中心監管收緊，AI基礎建設相關股票表現承壓。

paras_en: According to CNBC on the 4th, the Democratic Party captured both chambers of the US Congress in the midterm elections. With former President Trump saying he accepts the results, political uncertainty on Wall Street eased, and US stock futures rebounded sharply after a steep overnight drop, with Dow futures jumping more than 800 points. However, the market remains wary of tighter data‑center regulation, putting pressure on AI‑infrastructure stocks.

Yongfeng Bank held a press conference on the evening of the 4th regarding the abnormal transfer incident that occurred on the 3rd. The investigation found that an external hacker exploited a security‑setting vulnerability in the supplier of its new online‑banking transaction system. Chairman Cao Weishi and General Manager Zhuang Mingfu personally apologized to affected customers and the public, stating that although no financial loss occurred, the damage to the bank’s reputation was substantial. Yongfeng has now taken the system offline and is gathering evidence to pursue legal compensation against the foreign software supplier.

Advantech (2395‑TW) held a legal‑presentation meeting on the 4th. The company is optimistic that fourth‑quarter revenue will remain at a high level and may surpass the third‑quarter peak, and based on current order visibility, the outlook for next year is positive, with revenue expected to grow at a high double‑digit rate. In addition, economies of scale are beginning to show, so profit growth is expected to outpace revenue growth as a new normal.

Integrated circuit test‑maker Siliconware Precision Industries (6257‑TW) announced October revenue of NT$2.1 billion on the 4th, marking month‑over‑month and year‑over‑year growth and setting a new monthly record for the fourth consecutive month with revenue exceeding NT$2 billion. Siliconware said that with its deployment of photonic integrated circuit (PIC) and optical‑engine testing technologies, AI‑related product share is expected to break the 30% threshold.

During intraday trading on the 4th, the Taiwan stock index fell sharply, breaking the 42,000‑point level as the US midterm results and weakening US futures weighed on sentiment. The index swung a total of 1,885 points, the fourth‑largest intraday swing on record, and closed at 42,948 points with turnover reaching NT$1.1 trillion. Foreign investors withdrew about NT$149.8 billion, marking the fifth‑largest single‑day net sell‑off in history, heavily selling the actively managed ETF Active Unified Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW) with 84,000 lots, followed by the Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) with 77,000 lots, and in individual stocks, the 19‑strike put options on TSMC (2330‑TW) were the most sold.

items.title: 選後資金轉向！蘋果單日大漲逾5% 遠離AI資本支出戰場成科技股避風港
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周三(4日)股價大漲逾5%，創下一年多來最佳單日表現，進一步鞏固這家iPhone製造商作為科技投資人避風港的地位，顯示在人工智慧(AI)基礎設施投資受到期中選舉結果衝擊之後，投資人正轉向相對不受AI資本支出影響的科技巨頭。
蘋果周三終場上漲5.3%，收在每股349.51美元，是2025年5月以來最大單日漲幅。就在一周前，蘋果才於10月29日以348.91美元創下前一波歷史新高。
截至周三收盤，蘋果市值達5.08兆美元，進一步拉開與輝達(NVDA-US)的差距。輝達市值當日收盤為4.82兆美元。

AI基礎設施股低迷 蘋果成科技避風港

Equity Armor Investments執行長Luke Rahbari表示，蘋果股價飆升主要受到整體市場環境帶動，而非本身出現特定利多。民主黨在期中選舉大勝後，那斯達克綜合指數及其他主要指數周三同步上漲，顯示華爾街認為分裂政府可能減少監管政策意外，並抑制美國公債殖利率。
Rahbari認為，選舉結果也凸顯地方政府與居民反對資料中心的聲浪升高，這間接為蘋果帶來助力。
Rahbari說：「蘋果的獲利不仰賴興建資料中心。如果AI建設放緩，甚至可能緩解記憶體晶片成本上升對蘋果利潤率造成的壓力，不過蘋果目前仍預期記憶體價格將持續上漲。」
相較於其他科技巨頭投入數千億美元興建資料中心與AI基礎設施，蘋果一直控制支出，選擇與Google Gemini建立AI合作關係，並延續以庫藏股回購為核心的策略。這套紀律嚴謹的策略過去曾讓蘋果飽受批評，但如今在這種市場環境下反而派上用場。
不過，仰賴AI基礎設施持續擴建的硬體類股並未跟上漲勢，iShares半導體ETF(SOXX-US)周三下跌逾3%，被稱為「新興雲端服務商」(neoclouds)的AI雲端業者如CoreWeave(CRWV-US)股價下跌10%，晶片巨頭輝達也下跌3%。
超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)如微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Meta(META-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則逆勢收高，分析師指出，若資料中心供給受限，反而有利它們漲價。

投資人轉向大型股避險 但蘋果估值不便宜

Bahnsen Group投資長David Bahnsen表示，蘋果股價目前正收復周一公布財報後的跌幅。
他形容，蘋果「與其說是科技股，不如說更像消費股」。不過，蘋果不屬於超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)，反而成為一大優勢。
過去一個月以來，亞馬遜、Alphabet、Meta及微軟這些科技巨頭股價受到沉重壓力，投資人愈來愈擔心，企業投入AI基礎設施的數千億美元究竟能否帶來相應回報。
Bahnsen說：「投資人正在尋找大型科技股中的避風港，目前蘋果是這些股票之外的一個不錯選擇。」
他補充說：「蘋果有自己的步調。」但這種防禦性並不便宜，過去12個月本益比接近40倍，也就是投資人為公司每1美元獲利所支付的股價。
事實上，過去一年來，蘋果的估值已與整體科技產業大幅分歧。Jefferies交易部門分析師Jeffrey Favuzza上周指出，蘋果目前股價相當於未來預估獲利的35.8倍，接近多年高點。相較之下，那斯達克指數的預估本益比為20.3倍，過去12個月已大幅下滑。

items.title: 共和黨敗選後首波政治清算！赫格塞斯成美伊戰爭「替罪羔羊」 CNN：最快下周啟動彈劾投票
items.title_en: First Wave of Political Payback After GOP Election Loss! Hegseth Becomes the “Scapegoat” of the US‑Iran War, CNN: Impeachment Vote Could Start as Early as Next Week
paras: 美國期中選舉民主黨橫掃參眾兩院，共和黨內迅速掀起問責風暴，矛頭直指國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)，最新傳出多位共和黨議員與盟友將敗選歸咎於伊朗戰爭，認為赫格塞斯是推動開戰的關鍵人物，卻未規劃退場機制與政治後果管理。
《CNN》報導，肯塔基州共和黨籍眾議員Thomas Massie在眾議院復會後，將發起彈劾赫格塞思的投票，指控其未經國會授權對伊朗採取敵對行動、濫用職權。共和黨消息人士預期表決可過關，這將是現屆國會選後首波政治清算。
美國總統川普週三(4日)則公開力挺赫格塞斯，稱其「幹得非常好」、無意撤換，但顧問私下坦言，戰爭拖累選情下，「總得有人承擔責任，而不會是總統」。
美國副總統萬斯亦鬆口質疑伊朗戰事是否值得，共和黨參議員Thom Tillis直言赫格塞斯終將面臨「清算」，其與國會交惡更恐拖累1.5兆美元國防支出案。
民主黨已承諾展開廣泛調查，涵蓋伊朗軍事行動決策、高階將領「清洗」、烏克蘭政策，以及拉美海域疑似涉戰爭罪的反毒空襲。
另有傳聞稱，赫格塞斯可能轉任田納西州參議員，接替明年出任州長的Marsha Blackburn遺缺，川普僅稱「沒聽說過這種說法」。
分析指出，2006年小布希以倫斯斐為伊拉克戰爭背書的下課劇本正被重提。赫格塞思雖暫保官位，卻同時承受白宮止損、黨內倒戈、國會調查三重壓力，這場「替罪羔羊」博弈，將決定川普政府剩餘任期的國防路線與戰爭責任歸屬。
paras_en: The Democrats swept both houses of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, prompting an immediate accountability storm within the Republican Party that zeroes in on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Multiple GOP lawmakers and allies are blaming the loss on the war with Iran, arguing that Hegseth was the key figure who pushed the country into conflict without a clear exit strategy or political fallout management plan.

CNN reports that Republican Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky will launch an impeachment vote against Hegseth after the House reconvenes, accusing him of taking hostile action against Iran without congressional authorization and abusing his authority. Republican sources expect the vote to pass, marking the first wave of political payback in the current Congress after the election.

President Donald Trump publicly backed Hegseth on Wednesday (the 4th), calling his performance “very good” and saying there is no intention to replace him. However, advisers privately admitted that the war is hurting the administration’s electoral prospects and that “someone has to take responsibility, and it won’t be the president.”

Vice President Kamala Harris also hinted that the Iran war may not be worth it, while Republican Senator Thom Tillis bluntly said Hegseth will eventually face “payback,” warning that his clash with Congress could jeopardize a $1.5 trillion defense spending bill.

Democrats have pledged a broad investigation covering the decision‑making behind Iran’s military actions, a “purge” of senior officers, Ukraine policy, and alleged war‑crime‑related anti‑drug airstrikes in Latin American waters.

There are rumors that Hegseth could be appointed to the U.S. Senate from Tennessee to fill the seat that will be vacated by Governor‑elect Marsha Blackburn next year; Trump said he “has never heard of such a suggestion.”

Analysts note that the script used in 2006 when George W. Bush backed the Iraq war with the Lunsford‑type resignation is being revisited. While Hegseth currently retains his post, he is simultaneously under pressure from the White House to cut losses, from his party’s internal revolt, and from congressional investigations. This “scapegoat” showdown will determine the defense trajectory and war‑responsibility allocation for the remainder of the Trump administration’s term.

items.title: 期中選舉變天效應！微軟、亞馬遜市值合計單日暴增4240億美元 資料中心若受限反成利多？
items.title_en: Midterm Election Upset Boosts Microsoft and Amazon by $424 B in One Day; Data Center Restrictions May Actually Help?
paras: 民主黨在美國期中選舉拿下眾議院與參議院、取得重大勝利之後，多家科技巨頭周三(4日)股價大幅上漲，例如亞馬遜(Amazon)與微軟(MSFT-US)，單日市值合計暴增4240億美元。但與人工智慧(AI)相關個股、特別是與川普顧問馬斯克以及AI資料中心建設相關的股票，則應聲下跌。
周三上漲的許多科技股屬於所謂的「超大規模雲端服務商」(hyperscalers)，也就是規模最大的雲端服務業者。這些企業不僅投入龐大資本支出(capex)，也擁有強勁的自由現金流，且在興建AI資料中心方面具備最豐富的經驗與能力。
亞馬遜周三股價收漲6.1%，微軟上漲6.7%。根據道瓊市場數據，兩家公司當天市值合計增加4240億美元，其中亞馬遜增加1660億美元，微軟增加2590億美元。
同為雲端服務商的Alphabet(GOOGL-US)周三收漲3.2%，Meta Platforms(META-US)也收紅，上漲1.4%。
另一方面，特斯拉(TSLA-US)股價下跌2%，SpaceX下跌3%。為多數AI資料中心計畫供應晶片的輝達(NVDA-US)則小跌逾1%。規模較小、通常稱為「新興雲端服務商」(neoclouds)的AI雲端業者如CoreWeave(CRWV-US)股價下跌10%。
記憶體股方面，美光(MU-US)與SanDisk(SNDK-US)週三跌幅均超過 7%，SK海力士ADR(SKHY-US)也重挫逾 5%。

超大雲端服務商為何上漲？

周二晚間選舉結果陸續出爐時，部分觀察人士一開始認為，這對押注興建大型AI資料中心的科技巨頭而言可能是壞消息。周二共有41項地方公投提案，內容涵蓋限制AI資料中心或為其開發掃除障礙，選民在其中40項投票中反對資料中心。CNBC選民調查顯示，56%的選民表示，資料中心是影響其投票決定的重要或關鍵因素。
不過，專家指出幾項因素可能的原因。首先，民主黨贏得國會控制權，並拿下幾個關鍵州的州長席次後，科技業部分領域的投資人正擔心資料中心可能面臨新的開發限制，但微軟與亞馬遜的投資人或許認為，資料中心開發速度放緩未必是壞事。
德州州長當選人希諾霍薩(Gina Hinojosa)競選期間承諾，在州政府制定資料中心建設相關規範前，將立即暫停資料中心興建。現任共和黨籍州長艾伯特(Greg Abbott)則已於9月暫停核發資料中心許可，但監督團體FracTracker與公共公民組織(Public Citizen)的一份報告發現，該命令發布後，許可核發作業仍持續進行。

資料中心供給受限 反而有利雲端巨頭漲價

Gabelli Funds投資組合經理人John Belton表示，市場預期算力將持續供不應求，「未來資料中心容量若受到任何額外限制」，都可能讓亞馬遜與微軟等既有雲端服務業者得以調漲價格。
他補充，這可能改善企業利潤率，進而提高獲利能力。
另一種看法是，在新的政策環境下，微軟與亞馬遜可能放慢資料中心支出。考量AI投資已逐漸侵蝕這些企業創造的現金，投資人或許樂見資本支出降溫。

選後不確定性消退 帶動空頭回補

Tigress Financial Partners分析師Ivan Feinseth指出，微軟與亞馬遜受惠於「選後鬆一口氣、政策不確定性降低、投資人重新燃起對AI與雲端運算的熱情，以及大規模空頭回補」等因素。
他指出，投資人原本正為選後股市可能下跌預作準備，如今則開始「解除」防禦性部位。
Feinseth認為，這次選舉是亞馬遜與微軟等科技股短期內的催化因素，但持續的AI需求與基礎設施支出等「更具持續性的驅動因素」，才是長期推動這些股票走勢的關鍵。
paras_en: After the Democrats secured major victories in both the House and Senate in the U.S. midterm elections, several tech giants saw their stocks jump sharply on Wednesday (the 4th), with Amazon and Microsoft together adding $424 billion in market value in a single day. However, AI‑related stocks, especially those tied to Trump adviser Elon Musk and AI data‑center construction, fell in response.

Many of the tech stocks that rose on Wednesday belong to the so‑called “hyperscalers,” the largest cloud service providers. These firms not only pour massive capital expenditures into growth but also generate strong free cash flow and have the deepest experience and capability in building AI data centers.

Amazon closed up 6.1% on Wednesday, while Microsoft rose 6.7%. According to Dow Jones market data, the two companies’ combined market‑value increase that day was $424 billion, with Amazon adding $166 billion and Microsoft $259 billion.
Fellow cloud provider Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) gained 3.2% on Wednesday, and Meta Platforms (META‑US) also finished in the green, up 1.4%.

On the other hand, Tesla (TSLA‑US) fell 2% and SpaceX slipped 3%. Nvidia (NVDA‑US), a major chip supplier for most AI data‑center projects, dipped just over 1%. Smaller “neocloud” AI cloud players such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) saw their shares drop 10%.
In the memory‑chip sector, Micron (MU‑US) and SanDisk (SNDK‑US) each fell more than 7% on Wednesday, while SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) slumped over 5%.

Why did the hyperscalers rise? When election results started coming in on Tuesday night, some observers initially thought the outcome could be bad news for tech giants betting on large AI data‑center builds. Tuesday saw 41 local ballot measures covering either restrictions on AI data centers or the removal of obstacles to their development, and voters rejected data‑center proposals in 40 of those 41 votes. A CNBC poll showed 56% of voters said data‑center issues were an important or decisive factor in how they voted.

Experts point to several possible reasons. First, with Democrats gaining control of Congress and winning key governorships, investors in certain tech sectors worry that data‑center development could face new limits, but Microsoft and Amazon investors may view a slowdown in data‑center construction as not necessarily negative.

Gina Hinojosa, the winning Democratic candidate for Texas governor, pledged during her campaign to halt any data‑center construction until the state adopts related regulations. The incumbent Republican governor, Greg Abbott, already paused the issuance of data‑center permits in September, but a report by watchdog FracTracker and Public Citizen found that permit processing continued after the order was issued.

Limited data‑center supply could actually benefit cloud giants by allowing price hikes. John Belton, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds, said the market expects computing power to remain in short supply, and “any additional restriction on data‑center capacity in the future” could let incumbents like Amazon and Microsoft raise prices.
He added that such a scenario could improve corporate profit margins and boost earnings potential.

Another view is that under the new policy environment, Microsoft and Amazon may slow their data‑center spending. As AI investment increasingly eats into the cash these companies generate, investors might welcome a cooling of capital expenditures.

Post‑election uncertainty fading fuels short covering. Ivan Feinseth, analyst at Tigress Financial Partners, noted that Microsoft and Amazon benefited from “post‑election relief, reduced policy uncertainty, renewed investor enthusiasm for AI and cloud computing, and large‑scale short covering.”
He explained that investors had been positioning defensively in anticipation of a post‑election market decline, but are now beginning to unwind those defensive positions.

Feinseth believes the election acted as a short‑term catalyst for tech stocks like Amazon and Microsoft, but that sustained AI demand and ongoing infrastructure spending – “more durable drivers” – will be the key long‑term forces shaping these stocks’ trajectories.

items.title: 民主黨勝選成漲勢催化劑！市場押注AI支出降速推升現金流　五大科技巨頭齊漲、市值單日暴增1兆美元
items.title_en: Democratic Party Victory Acts as a Rally Catalyst! Market Bets AI‑Spending Slowdown Boosts Cash Flow—All Five Tech Giants Rise, Market‑Cap Surges $1 Trillion in a Day
paras: 美國期中選舉結果牽動美國科技股走勢，五大科技巨頭週三(4日)股價集體跳漲，投資人押注民主黨掌控國會後，將放緩正瘋狂吞噬自由現金流的AI巨額支出，亞馬遜盤中一度大漲8.3%，微軟漲7%，Alphabet漲5.9%，Meta漲3.6%；連同避開AI重資產投入、一度漲逾6%的蘋果，五家巨頭合計市值料增近1兆美元。
民主黨在週二(3日)期中選舉中拿下參眾兩院多數，翻轉南卡羅來納、德州、堪薩斯等傳統共和黨票倉，並擴大州級執政版圖，其競選核心主張之一，正是審查AI資料中心大規模建設、強化地方監管。
Dakota Wealth資深投組經理人Robert Pavlik說，「市場反應就像在慶祝AI建設週期結束」，並稱若超大规模雲端業者不再砸千億建算力，自由現金流就有望由負轉正。
瑞銀策略報告亦引述出口民調指出，選民強烈反對社區新建資料中心，「藍色浪潮」最大衝擊將來自各州加強監管。
事實上，科技七巨頭近期持續承壓。自10月21日Meta揭開雲端財報季以來，彭博七巨頭指數已下跌5.9%，今年迄今漲幅減少至4.1%，落後標普500與那斯達克100。亞馬遜、Alphabet、Meta自由現金流均已轉負，資本支出靠發債與股權融資支撐。
分析師認為，週三行情雖帶投機色彩，卻點出關鍵轉變，也就是市場對自由現金流的敏感度已壓過AI敘事。雲端巨頭原本身處兩難，如今選舉像一份禮物，剎車由政府來踩。
paras_en: The results of the U.S. midterm elections are influencing the direction of American tech stocks. On Wednesday (the 4th), the shares of the five major tech giants all jumped, as investors bet that a Democratic‑controlled Congress will slow the massive AI spending that has been devouring free cash flow. Amazon surged as much as 8.3% intraday, Microsoft rose 7%, Alphabet 5.9%, Meta 3.6%, and even Apple—avoiding heavy AI‑related capital outlays—spiked more than 6%. Together, the five firms are expected to add nearly $1 trillion to their combined market value.

The Democrats captured majorities in both the House and Senate on Tuesday (the 3rd), flipping traditional Republican strongholds such as South Carolina, Texas and Kansas and expanding their state‑level governing footprint. One of their core campaign pledges is to scrutinize the large‑scale construction of AI data centers and tighten local regulation.

Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth, said, “The market’s reaction is like a celebration that the AI‑building cycle is ending,” adding that if the ultra‑large cloud providers stop pouring hundreds of billions into compute capacity, free cash flow could swing from negative to positive.

A UBS strategy report, citing an export poll, also noted that voters are strongly opposed to new community data centers, and that the biggest impact of the “blue wave” will come from tighter regulation at the state level.

In fact, the seven major tech firms have been under pressure lately. Since Meta kicked off the cloud earnings season on October 21, Bloomberg’s seven‑giant index has fallen 5.9%, and its year‑to‑date gain has shrunk to 4.1%, lagging both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq‑100. Amazon, Alphabet and Meta have all turned negative on free cash flow, with capital expenditures now being funded by debt and equity issuance.

Analysts say Wednesday’s market move, while speculative, highlights a key shift: sensitivity to free cash flow now outweighs the AI narrative. Cloud giants, previously caught in a dilemma, now see the election as a gift—braking power coming from the government.

items.title: HP延攬前GSK執行長記憶體漲價考驗PC轉型
items.title_en: HP Hires Former GSK CEO, Memory Price Hike Tests PC Transformation
paras: 2026年11月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 惠普HP(HPQ-US)11月4日宣布，延攬前葛蘭素史克（GSK）執行長Emma Walmsley出任執行長，將於2027年1月4日接任。PC產業正面臨記憶體供給吃緊與成本上升，公司在此時換帥，新團隊能否在市場縮量之際守住獲利、擴大AI PC等高階產品業務，成為後續觀察重點。
Walmsley將接替暫代執行長Bruce Broussard，後者轉任董事長，接替Chip Bergh。她曾於2017年至2025年底領導GSK，並參與消費保健事業Haleon的分拆，也已擔任微軟董事七年，但過去沒有科技硬體產業的經營經驗。
HP面對的壓力不只來自換機需求。AI資料中心大量建置，吸收記憶體產能，讓PC品牌同時承受零組件漲價與市場需求疲弱。HP在8月公布的2026會計年度第三季業績中，PC出貨量減少16%，個人系統事業營收卻成長18%，反映銷售組合轉向價格與毛利較高的機種，包括AI PC，營收成長並非來自出貨量回升。
公司9月向美國證管會提交的文件指出，尚未提供2027會計年度財測，並以明年整體PC產業出貨量下滑中個位數百分比作為假設。Capital.com資深市場專家Vitor Madeira認為，Walmsley領導大型企業重整的經驗，是HP此刻所需；接下來的考驗，是在記憶體成本緩和前保護獲利，並從AI裝置等領域尋找成長。

paras_en: On November 4, HP (HPQ-US) announced that it will appoint former GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) chief executive Emma Walmsley as its new CEO, effective January 4, 2027. The PC industry is facing tight memory supply and rising costs, and the leadership change comes at a critical time; observers will watch whether the new team can protect profits and expand high‑end AI PC business amid a shrinking market.

Walmsley will replace interim CEO Bruce Broussard, who is moving to the chairman role, succeeding Chip Bergh. She led GSK from 2017 until the end of 2025, oversaw the spin‑off of consumer‑health business Haleon, and has served on Microsoft’s board for seven years, but she has no prior experience running a technology‑hardware company.

HP’s challenges go beyond replacement demand. Massive AI data‑center builds are soaking up memory capacity, leaving PC brands to contend with component price hikes and weak market demand. In HP’s third‑quarter results for fiscal 2026 released in August, PC shipments fell 16% while revenue from the Personal Systems segment rose 18%, reflecting a shift toward higher‑priced, higher‑margin models such as AI PCs; the revenue growth did not stem from a rebound in unit shipments.

A filing the company submitted to the U.S. SEC in September noted that it has not yet provided a fiscal‑2027 outlook and is assuming a single‑digit percentage decline in overall PC industry shipments next year. Senior market analyst Vitor Madeira of Capital.com believes Walmsley’s experience reshaping large enterprises is exactly what HP needs now; the next test will be protecting profitability before memory costs ease and finding growth in AI devices and related areas.

items.title: CVS拆分藥局與醫療保險業務預計2028年上半年完成
items.title_en: CVS to Split Pharmacy and Health Insurance Businesses, Aiming to Complete in Early 2028
paras: 2026年11月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國醫療與藥局集團CVS Health(CVS-US)11月4日宣布，計畫將零售藥局業務分拆為獨立公司，與Aetna醫療保險及Caremark藥品福利管理業務分開，預計2028年上半年完成。現有股東屆時將同時持有兩家公司的股份，為集團多年來整合藥局、保險與醫療服務的經營模式帶來重大轉變。
分拆後，CVS Health將由現任執行長David Joyner領軍，保留Aetna、Caremark、特殊藥品藥局，以及Oak Street Health與Signify Health等醫療服務事業。獨立的CVS Pharmacy則由Prem Shah出任執行長，涵蓋零售藥局、MinuteClinics診所、郵購藥局與Health100照護管理平台。
CVS旗下約有9,000家藥局。Joyner表示，過去兩年藥局、Caremark與Aetna營運均已有明顯改善，讓公司有條件調整組織。他指出，藥局透過改善門市技術提高處理量，並改變處方藥給付模式，在提供較低價格的同時，仍能從品牌藥與學名藥取得利潤。不過，處方藥配送服務興起也減少顧客到店與額外購物，傳統連鎖藥局仍面臨給付壓力及線上競爭。
公司將2026年調整後每股盈餘預測上修至至少8.20美元，並預估2027年至少8.65美元，高於分析師平均預期的8.53美元。財務長Brian Newman同時提醒，明年藥品福利管理業務將面臨政府折扣藥價計畫相關挑戰，新業務承攬情況較弱，醫療保險會員數也將減少；偏高的醫療成本仍使公司對今年剩餘時間維持審慎看法。
分拆消息未能提振股價，CVS在11月4日美股午後交易下跌約13%。巴克萊分析師Andrew Mok指出，分拆缺乏詳細財務資訊，是投資人主要疑慮之一。醫療產業多年整併也持續受到監管機關與客戶檢視，外界質疑同時經營保險、藥品管理與藥局是否形成利益衝突；瑞銀分析師Kevin Caliendo認為，市場將此次分拆視為因應監管壓力的防禦措施，而非主動擴張。

paras_en: On November 4, CVS Health (CVS-US) announced that it plans to spin off its retail pharmacy business into a separate company, separating it from its Aetna health insurance and Caremark pharmacy benefit management operations, with the split expected to be completed in the first half of 2028. Existing shareholders will then hold shares in both companies, marking a major shift in the group's long‑standing integrated model of pharmacies, insurance and health services.

After the split, CVS Health will be led by current CEO David Joyner and will retain Aetna, Caremark, specialty drug pharmacies, as well as medical service businesses such as Oak Street Health and Signify Health. The independent CVS Pharmacy will be headed by Prem Shah as CEO and will encompass retail pharmacies, MinuteClinic clinics, mail‑order pharmacy and the Health100 care‑management platform.

CVS operates roughly 9,000 pharmacy locations. Joyner said that over the past two years the pharmacy, Caremark and Aetna businesses have all shown clear improvements, giving the company the conditions to restructure. He noted that pharmacies have increased throughput by upgrading store technology and have altered prescription drug reimbursement models, allowing lower prices while still earning margins on brand‑name and generic drugs. However, the rise of prescription‑delivery services has reduced in‑store traffic and ancillary purchases, and traditional chain pharmacies continue to face reimbursement pressure and online competition.

The company raised its adjusted earnings‑per‑share outlook for 2026 to at least $8.20 and projects at least $8.65 for 2027, above the analyst average forecast of $8.53. CFO Brian Newman also warned that next year the pharmacy‑benefit‑management segment will confront challenges from government drug‑price discount programs, that new‑business wins are weaker, and that health‑insurance membership will decline; elevated medical costs keep the company cautious for the remainder of the year.

The split announcement did not lift the stock, with CVS shares falling about 13% in afternoon trading on November 4. Barclays analyst Andrew Mok said the lack of detailed financial information about the spin‑off is a key investor concern. The health‑care sector’s long‑standing consolidation continues to draw regulatory and customer scrutiny, and critics question whether operating insurance, drug‑benefit management and pharmacies simultaneously creates conflicts of interest. UBS analyst Kevin Caliendo believes the market views the split as a defensive move to address regulatory pressure rather than a proactive expansion.

items.title: Meta首發90億歐元債券AI基建融資擴向歐洲
items.title_en: Meta Launches €9 Billion Bond, Expanding AI Infrastructure Financing to Europe
paras: 2026年11月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Meta Platforms(META-US)11月4日首次發行歐元計價債券，募得90億歐元（約新台幣3,315億元），債券期限從4年到38年不等。在AI資料中心與運算設施投資持續擴大之際，這家Facebook母公司繼美元市場後，再向歐洲投資人籌措長期資金。
Meta前一天才透過五批美元債券籌得150億美元（約新台幣4,924億元）。兩天接連在不同幣別市場發債，反映大型科技公司的AI建設資金需求，已不再只靠原有現金支應，外部融資的重要性隨之提高。
歐洲債市也是其他科技巨頭近期的募資管道。Alphabet(GOOGL-US)本週一發行60億歐元（約新台幣2,210億元）債券，認購金額超過170億歐元（約新台幣6,262億元）。除擴大投資人來源外，外幣債券也可用來搭配海外資產、降低匯率風險，並利用不同市場的融資成本差異。
不過，籌資管道暢通並不代表市場對AI投資回收已無疑慮。近期投資人持續關注龐大資本支出需要多少融資，以及未來收益能否支撐投入規模，相關疑慮已壓抑科技股與債券表現，那斯達克指數10月下跌5%。

paras_en: On November 4, Meta Platforms (META-US) issued its first euro‑denominated bonds, raising €9 billion (about NT$331.5 billion). The bonds have maturities ranging from 4 to 38 years. As the company continues to expand investment in AI data centers and computing facilities, the Facebook parent is now tapping European investors for long‑term funding after having done so in the U.S. dollar market.

The day before, Meta raised $15 billion (about NT$492.4 billion) through five tranches of U.S. dollar bonds. Issuing debt in two different currency markets within two days underscores the growing financing needs of large tech firms for AI construction, which can no longer rely solely on existing cash reserves, making external financing increasingly important.

European bond markets have also become a fundraising channel for other tech giants. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) issued €6 billion (about NT$221 billion) of bonds on Monday, with orders exceeding €17 billion (about NT$626.2 billion). In addition to broadening the investor base, foreign‑currency bonds can be used to match overseas assets, reduce exchange‑rate risk, and take advantage of cost differentials across markets.

However, smooth fundraising does not mean the market has no doubts about AI investment returns. Investors are closely watching how much financing is needed for massive capital expenditures and whether future earnings can support the scale of spending. Such concerns have been weighing on tech stocks and bonds, with the Nasdaq index down 5% in October.

items.title: 北極冷空氣恐提前南下 歐洲天然氣庫存再添壓力
items.title_en: Arctic Cold Air May Move South Earlier, Adding Pressure to Europe’s Gas Inventories
paras: 今年北極冷空氣可能比往年更早南下，令庫存已處多年低點的歐洲天然氣市場再添變數，歐洲距離更深一輪能源危機或許只差幾次寒潮。
歐洲中期天氣預報中心（ECMWF）的預報顯示，北極極渦可能提前受到擾動，進而將冷空氣推向西北歐。極渦是冬季盤踞在北極上空的冷空氣團，一旦受到擾動而減弱或變形，冷空氣就會向南擴散。
此前已有媒體報導，北極上空高層大氣今年可能出現有記錄以來最早的一次急劇升溫。這種升溫可能導致極渦分裂，北極冷空氣可能在數周內侵襲美國北部和歐洲部分地區。
據英國氣象局介紹，2018年初席捲英國的「東方野獸」寒潮，就與這類高空急劇升溫有關。
對於儲氣緩衝本已偏薄的歐洲而言，這一氣象變化可能迅速轉化為能源壓力。據能源研究機構測算，若12月2日至8日歐洲平均氣溫較過去10年同期常年水準低攝氏5度，西北歐以及義大利、西班牙、奧地利的供暖用氣需求將增加約11億立方公尺。
如果這部分需求全部依靠庫存滿足，明年3月底歐洲儲氣率將從正常天氣下的約17%降至15.5%左右，僅比該機構估算的最低水準高出約0.5個百分點。一旦跌破最低水平，意味著商業庫存基本耗盡，歐洲將開始動用部分國家的戰略儲備天然氣。
值得注意的是，這一周潛在寒潮帶來的額外消耗，已足以抹平10月暖冬換來的額外積累。10月氣溫偏暖，供暖用氣減少，歐洲得以繼續往儲氣庫裡補充天然氣，當月新增儲氣量較2021年至2025年同期均值多出約10億立方公尺。
即便如此，歐洲入冬時的天然氣庫存仍僅約容量的74%，處於2022年能源危機以來同期最低。
國際能源署（IEA）3日也在最新報告中警告，歐洲天然氣庫存偏低，一旦遭遇供應中斷將難以招架，明年3月下旬庫存可能降至10%以下。
paras_en: This year the Arctic cold air may move south earlier than in previous years, adding a new variable to Europe’s natural‑gas market, which has been at multi‑year lows, and bringing the continent a few cold snaps away from a deeper energy crisis.

The European Centre for Medium‑Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) predicts that the Arctic polar vortex could be disturbed earlier than usual, pushing cold air toward north‑west Europe. The polar vortex is a mass of cold air that sits over the Arctic in winter; if it is weakened or deformed by a disturbance, the cold air spreads southward.

Earlier media reports have noted that the upper atmosphere over the Arctic could experience the earliest recorded rapid warming this year. Such warming could cause the polar vortex to split, allowing Arctic cold air to invade parts of the United States and Europe within a few weeks.
According to the UK Met Office, the “Beast from the East” cold spell that swept Britain in early 2018 was linked to this type of rapid upper‑air warming.

For Europe, whose gas‑storage buffers are already thin, this weather shift could quickly turn into energy pressure. Energy‑research institutes estimate that if the average temperature across Europe from Dec 2‑8 is 5 °C below the ten‑year historical average, heating‑gas demand in north‑west Europe, Italy, Spain and Austria would rise by roughly 1.1 billion cubic metres.

If that extra demand had to be met entirely from inventories, Europe’s storage rate would fall from about 17 % under normal weather to roughly 15.5 % by the end of March next year – only about 0.5 percentage points above the institute’s estimated minimum level. Falling below that threshold would mean commercial stocks are essentially exhausted and Europe would have to tap strategic gas reserves of some member states.

It is worth noting that the additional consumption from the potential cold snap this week is already enough to erase the extra gas accumulation achieved during the warm October. The milder October reduced heating demand, allowing Europe to keep filling storage, and the net addition that month was about 1 billion cubic metres more than the average for the same period in 2021‑2025.
Nevertheless, Europe’s gas inventories at the start of winter remain only about 74 % of capacity, the lowest level for the same period since the 2022 energy crisis.

The International Energy Agency (IEA) warned on the 3rd that Europe’s gas stocks are low and would struggle to cope with supply disruptions, with inventories potentially falling below 10 % by late March next year.

items.title: 選後資金轉向！蘋果單日大漲逾5% 遠離AI資本支出戰場成科技股避風港
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)周三(4日)股價大漲逾5%，創下一年多來最佳單日表現，進一步鞏固這家iPhone製造商作為科技投資人避風港的地位，顯示在人工智慧(AI)基礎設施投資受到期中選舉結果衝擊之後，投資人正轉向相對不受AI資本支出影響的科技巨頭。
蘋果周三終場上漲5.3%，收在每股349.51美元，是2025年5月以來最大單日漲幅。就在一周前，蘋果才於10月29日以348.91美元創下前一波歷史新高。
截至周三收盤，蘋果市值達5.08兆美元，進一步拉開與輝達(NVDA-US)的差距。輝達市值當日收盤為4.82兆美元。

AI基礎設施股低迷 蘋果成科技避風港

Equity Armor Investments執行長Luke Rahbari表示，蘋果股價飆升主要受到整體市場環境帶動，而非本身出現特定利多。民主黨在期中選舉大勝後，那斯達克綜合指數及其他主要指數周三同步上漲，顯示華爾街認為分裂政府可能減少監管政策意外，並抑制美國公債殖利率。
Rahbari認為，選舉結果也凸顯地方政府與居民反對資料中心的聲浪升高，這間接為蘋果帶來助力。
Rahbari說：「蘋果的獲利不仰賴興建資料中心。如果AI建設放緩，甚至可能緩解記憶體晶片成本上升對蘋果利潤率造成的壓力，不過蘋果目前仍預期記憶體價格將持續上漲。」
相較於其他科技巨頭投入數千億美元興建資料中心與AI基礎設施，蘋果一直控制支出，選擇與Google Gemini建立AI合作關係，並延續以庫藏股回購為核心的策略。這套紀律嚴謹的策略過去曾讓蘋果飽受批評，但如今在這種市場環境下反而派上用場。
不過，仰賴AI基礎設施持續擴建的硬體類股並未跟上漲勢，iShares半導體ETF(SOXX-US)周三下跌逾3%，被稱為「新興雲端服務商」(neoclouds)的AI雲端業者如CoreWeave(CRWV-US)股價下跌10%，晶片巨頭輝達也下跌3%。
超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)如微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)、Meta(META-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)則逆勢收高，分析師指出，若資料中心供給受限，反而有利它們漲價。

投資人轉向大型股避險 但蘋果估值不便宜

Bahnsen Group投資長David Bahnsen表示，蘋果股價目前正收復周一公布財報後的跌幅。
他形容，蘋果「與其說是科技股，不如說更像消費股」。不過，蘋果不屬於超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)，反而成為一大優勢。
過去一個月以來，亞馬遜、Alphabet、Meta及微軟這些科技巨頭股價受到沉重壓力，投資人愈來愈擔心，企業投入AI基礎設施的數千億美元究竟能否帶來相應回報。
Bahnsen說：「投資人正在尋找大型科技股中的避風港，目前蘋果是這些股票之外的一個不錯選擇。」
他補充說：「蘋果有自己的步調。」但這種防禦性並不便宜，過去12個月本益比接近40倍，也就是投資人為公司每1美元獲利所支付的股價。
事實上，過去一年來，蘋果的估值已與整體科技產業大幅分歧。Jefferies交易部門分析師Jeffrey Favuzza上周指出，蘋果目前股價相當於未來預估獲利的35.8倍，接近多年高點。相較之下，那斯達克指數的預估本益比為20.3倍，過去12個月已大幅下滑。

items.title: 超市「冷櫃變暖箱」只是開始？英國警告：更多攻擊恐在路上
items.title_en: Supermarket “Freezer Turns Into Heater” Just the Start? UK Warns More Attacks Likely Ahead
paras: 英國網路安全負責人周二（3日）表示，歐洲多地超市冷凍櫃遭駭客攻擊的事件只是一記早期警鐘，老舊技術跟不上駭客進化，類似事件恐怕會愈發頻繁。
瑞典、比利時、法國等多國超市的冷櫃與冰櫃周一相繼遭遇網路攻擊。這些攻擊撕開了老舊IT系統的防線漏洞，令冷凍櫃一夜變「加熱櫃」，致使大量食品變質報廢，門市損失慘重。
英國國家網路安全中心主任理查德·霍恩表示，此次事件可以說還僅僅只是冰山一角。
「眼下潛伏著大量漏洞，從某種角度來說，它們就像在被動排隊等待被利用，」霍恩說道，「我們在短期內面臨的最嚴峻威脅，正是這類攻擊事件爆發式增長。」
英國政府通訊總部在年度報告中指出，預計未來幾年AI將增強駭客的能力。英國國家網路安全中心官員表示，在冷櫃攻擊事件中，駭客可能都不需要使用先進AI，因為這些攻擊針對的是舊技術已知漏洞。
霍恩表示，AI將使發現此類舊漏洞變得越來越容易，並能大規模加以利用。
「我們必須清醒認識到這絕非AI開創了什麼全新攻擊手法，而是那些被放任太久脆弱點，如今以過去難以想像的規模被機器式挖掘和放大利用。」霍恩說道。
paras_en: UK cyber‑security chief said on Tuesday (the 3rd) that the recent hacks of supermarket freezers across Europe are only an early warning sign; outdated technology can’t keep up with evolving hackers, and similar incidents are likely to become more frequent.

Freezers and chillers in supermarkets in Sweden, Belgium, France and other countries were hit by cyber‑attacks on Monday. The attacks exploited gaps in legacy IT systems, turning freezers into “heating units” overnight, causing massive food spoilage and heavy losses for retailers.
Richard Horn, director of the UK National Cyber Security Centre, said the incidents are just the tip of the iceberg.

“There are a huge number of vulnerabilities lying in wait, and in a sense they’re passively queuing to be exploited,” Horn said. “The most severe threat we face in the short term is the explosive growth of this type of attack.”

The UK Government Communications Headquarters noted in its annual report that AI is expected to boost hackers’ capabilities in the coming years. NCSC officials said that in the freezer attacks, hackers likely didn’t need advanced AI because they were exploiting known flaws in old technology.
Horn said AI will make it increasingly easy to discover such legacy vulnerabilities and to weaponise them at scale.

“We must recognise that this is not AI inventing brand‑new attack methods, but rather long‑neglected weak points now being mined and amplified by machines on a scale previously unimaginable,” Horn warned.

paras: 美國期中選舉民主黨橫掃參眾兩院，共和黨內迅速掀起問責風暴，矛頭直指國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)，最新傳出多位共和黨議員與盟友將敗選歸咎於伊朗戰爭，認為赫格塞斯是推動開戰的關鍵人物，卻未規劃退場機制與政治後果管理。
《CNN》報導，肯塔基州共和黨籍眾議員Thomas Massie在眾議院復會後，將發起彈劾赫格塞思的投票，指控其未經國會授權對伊朗採取敵對行動、濫用職權。共和黨消息人士預期表決可過關，這將是現屆國會選後首波政治清算。
美國總統川普週三(4日)則公開力挺赫格塞斯，稱其「幹得非常好」、無意撤換，但顧問私下坦言，戰爭拖累選情下，「總得有人承擔責任，而不會是總統」。
美國副總統萬斯亦鬆口質疑伊朗戰事是否值得，共和黨參議員Thom Tillis直言赫格塞斯終將面臨「清算」，其與國會交惡更恐拖累1.5兆美元國防支出案。
民主黨已承諾展開廣泛調查，涵蓋伊朗軍事行動決策、高階將領「清洗」、烏克蘭政策，以及拉美海域疑似涉戰爭罪的反毒空襲。
另有傳聞稱，赫格塞斯可能轉任田納西州參議員，接替明年出任州長的Marsha Blackburn遺缺，川普僅稱「沒聽說過這種說法」。
分析指出，2006年小布希以倫斯斐為伊拉克戰爭背書的下課劇本正被重提。赫格塞思雖暫保官位，卻同時承受白宮止損、黨內倒戈、國會調查三重壓力，這場「替罪羔羊」博弈，將決定川普政府剩餘任期的國防路線與戰爭責任歸屬。
paras_en: The Democrats swept both houses of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, prompting an immediate accountability storm within the Republican Party that zeroes in on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Multiple GOP lawmakers and allies are blaming the loss on the war with Iran, arguing that Hegseth was the key figure who pushed the country into conflict without a clear exit strategy or political fallout management plan.

CNN reports that Republican Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky will launch an impeachment vote against Hegseth after the House reconvenes, accusing him of taking hostile action against Iran without congressional authorization and abusing his authority. Republican sources expect the vote to pass, marking the first wave of political payback in the current Congress after the election.

President Donald Trump publicly backed Hegseth on Wednesday (the 4th), calling his performance “very good” and saying there is no intention to replace him. However, advisers privately admitted that the war is hurting the administration’s electoral prospects and that “someone has to take responsibility, and it won’t be the president.”

Vice President Kamala Harris also hinted that the Iran war may not be worth it, while Republican Senator Thom Tillis bluntly said Hegseth will eventually face “payback,” warning that his clash with Congress could jeopardize a $1.5 trillion defense spending bill.

Democrats have pledged a broad investigation covering the decision‑making behind Iran’s military actions, a “purge” of senior officers, Ukraine policy, and alleged war‑crime‑related anti‑drug airstrikes in Latin American waters.

There are rumors that Hegseth could be appointed to the U.S. Senate from Tennessee to fill the seat that will be vacated by Governor‑elect Marsha Blackburn next year; Trump said he “has never heard of such a suggestion.”

Analysts note that the script used in 2006 when George W. Bush backed the Iraq war with the Lunsford‑type resignation is being revisited. While Hegseth currently retains his post, he is simultaneously under pressure from the White House to cut losses, from his party’s internal revolt, and from congressional investigations. This “scapegoat” showdown will determine the defense trajectory and war‑responsibility allocation for the remainder of the Trump administration’s term.

paras: 法國血液機構（EFS）4日（周三）證實，三處儲存重要血液製品的冷庫遭網攻，冷庫溫度被調至「極高」，所幸警報系統及時發出警告，技術人員得以在血液製品受損前採取干預措施。
此次攻擊發生在當地時間1日晚至2日凌晨。與此同時，歐洲近十個國家的超市冰箱和冷凍設備溫度異常飆升，部分設備溫度甚至達到攝氏50度，造成價值數百萬歐元食品損失。
EFS是法國公共輸血服務機構，負責採集、檢測、製備和配送血液、血漿及血小板等製品，為全法1,900多家醫院提供服務。
EFS表示，該機構本身並非駭客的直接攻擊目標，遭到攻擊的是承包商旗下冷庫。
受影響冷庫中儲存的血液製品，包括用於輸血和藥品生產的袋裝血漿，均已轉移至其他地點。
該機構稱，技術團隊正與法國國家資訊系統安全局及衛生部保持聯繫，並加強對所有設備運行情況的監測。
上個月法國曾發生一系列類似網路攻擊，駭客控制了700家超市製冷設備。一名消息人士4日透露，法國互助信貸銀行集團旗下Crédit Mutuel Arkéa也遭駭客入侵，電腦系統受到攻擊，造成超過1億美元損失。
paras_en: France's blood agency (EFS) confirmed on Wednesday the 4th that three cold storage units holding critical blood products were targeted by a cyberattack, with temperatures raised to "extremely high". Fortunately, the alarm system triggered in time, allowing technicians to intervene before the blood products were damaged.

The attack occurred from the evening of the 1st to the early hours of the 2nd local time. At the same time, supermarket refrigerators and freezers in nearly ten European countries experienced abnormal temperature spikes, some reaching 50°C, resulting in food losses worth millions of euros.
EFS is France's public blood service, responsible for collecting, testing, preparing and distributing blood, plasma and platelet products, serving more than 1,900 hospitals nationwide.
EFS said the agency itself was not the direct target of the hackers; the compromised facilities were cold storage units operated by a contractor.
The affected freezers stored blood products, including bagged plasma used for transfusions and drug manufacturing, all of which have been relocated to other sites.
The agency stated its technical team is in contact with the French National Cybersecurity Agency and the Health Ministry, and is intensifying monitoring of all equipment operations.

Last month France experienced a series of similar cyberattacks, with hackers taking control of refrigeration equipment in 700 supermarkets. A source told on the 4th that Crédit Mutuel Arkéa, part of the French mutual credit bank group, was also breached, its computer systems attacked, causing losses exceeding $100 million.

items.title: 期中選舉變天效應！微軟、亞馬遜市值合計單日暴增4240億美元 資料中心若受限反成利多？
items.title_en: Midterm Election Upset Boosts Microsoft and Amazon by $424 B in One Day; Data Center Restrictions May Actually Help?
paras: 民主黨在美國期中選舉拿下眾議院與參議院、取得重大勝利之後，多家科技巨頭周三(4日)股價大幅上漲，例如亞馬遜(Amazon)與微軟(MSFT-US)，單日市值合計暴增4240億美元。但與人工智慧(AI)相關個股、特別是與川普顧問馬斯克以及AI資料中心建設相關的股票，則應聲下跌。
周三上漲的許多科技股屬於所謂的「超大規模雲端服務商」(hyperscalers)，也就是規模最大的雲端服務業者。這些企業不僅投入龐大資本支出(capex)，也擁有強勁的自由現金流，且在興建AI資料中心方面具備最豐富的經驗與能力。
亞馬遜周三股價收漲6.1%，微軟上漲6.7%。根據道瓊市場數據，兩家公司當天市值合計增加4240億美元，其中亞馬遜增加1660億美元，微軟增加2590億美元。
同為雲端服務商的Alphabet(GOOGL-US)周三收漲3.2%，Meta Platforms(META-US)也收紅，上漲1.4%。
另一方面，特斯拉(TSLA-US)股價下跌2%，SpaceX下跌3%。為多數AI資料中心計畫供應晶片的輝達(NVDA-US)則小跌逾1%。規模較小、通常稱為「新興雲端服務商」(neoclouds)的AI雲端業者如CoreWeave(CRWV-US)股價下跌10%。
記憶體股方面，美光(MU-US)與SanDisk(SNDK-US)週三跌幅均超過 7%，SK海力士ADR(SKHY-US)也重挫逾 5%。

超大雲端服務商為何上漲？

周二晚間選舉結果陸續出爐時，部分觀察人士一開始認為，這對押注興建大型AI資料中心的科技巨頭而言可能是壞消息。周二共有41項地方公投提案，內容涵蓋限制AI資料中心或為其開發掃除障礙，選民在其中40項投票中反對資料中心。CNBC選民調查顯示，56%的選民表示，資料中心是影響其投票決定的重要或關鍵因素。
不過，專家指出幾項因素可能的原因。首先，民主黨贏得國會控制權，並拿下幾個關鍵州的州長席次後，科技業部分領域的投資人正擔心資料中心可能面臨新的開發限制，但微軟與亞馬遜的投資人或許認為，資料中心開發速度放緩未必是壞事。
德州州長當選人希諾霍薩(Gina Hinojosa)競選期間承諾，在州政府制定資料中心建設相關規範前，將立即暫停資料中心興建。現任共和黨籍州長艾伯特(Greg Abbott)則已於9月暫停核發資料中心許可，但監督團體FracTracker與公共公民組織(Public Citizen)的一份報告發現，該命令發布後，許可核發作業仍持續進行。

資料中心供給受限 反而有利雲端巨頭漲價

Gabelli Funds投資組合經理人John Belton表示，市場預期算力將持續供不應求，「未來資料中心容量若受到任何額外限制」，都可能讓亞馬遜與微軟等既有雲端服務業者得以調漲價格。
他補充，這可能改善企業利潤率，進而提高獲利能力。
另一種看法是，在新的政策環境下，微軟與亞馬遜可能放慢資料中心支出。考量AI投資已逐漸侵蝕這些企業創造的現金，投資人或許樂見資本支出降溫。

選後不確定性消退 帶動空頭回補

Tigress Financial Partners分析師Ivan Feinseth指出，微軟與亞馬遜受惠於「選後鬆一口氣、政策不確定性降低、投資人重新燃起對AI與雲端運算的熱情，以及大規模空頭回補」等因素。
他指出，投資人原本正為選後股市可能下跌預作準備，如今則開始「解除」防禦性部位。
Feinseth認為，這次選舉是亞馬遜與微軟等科技股短期內的催化因素，但持續的AI需求與基礎設施支出等「更具持續性的驅動因素」，才是長期推動這些股票走勢的關鍵。
paras_en: After the Democrats secured major victories in both the House and Senate in the U.S. midterm elections, several tech giants saw their stocks jump sharply on Wednesday (the 4th), with Amazon and Microsoft together adding $424 billion in market value in a single day. However, AI‑related stocks, especially those tied to Trump adviser Elon Musk and AI data‑center construction, fell in response.

Many of the tech stocks that rose on Wednesday belong to the so‑called “hyperscalers,” the largest cloud service providers. These firms not only pour massive capital expenditures into growth but also generate strong free cash flow and have the deepest experience and capability in building AI data centers.

Amazon closed up 6.1% on Wednesday, while Microsoft rose 6.7%. According to Dow Jones market data, the two companies’ combined market‑value increase that day was $424 billion, with Amazon adding $166 billion and Microsoft $259 billion.
Fellow cloud provider Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) gained 3.2% on Wednesday, and Meta Platforms (META‑US) also finished in the green, up 1.4%.

On the other hand, Tesla (TSLA‑US) fell 2% and SpaceX slipped 3%. Nvidia (NVDA‑US), a major chip supplier for most AI data‑center projects, dipped just over 1%. Smaller “neocloud” AI cloud players such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) saw their shares drop 10%.
In the memory‑chip sector, Micron (MU‑US) and SanDisk (SNDK‑US) each fell more than 7% on Wednesday, while SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) slumped over 5%.

Why did the hyperscalers rise? When election results started coming in on Tuesday night, some observers initially thought the outcome could be bad news for tech giants betting on large AI data‑center builds. Tuesday saw 41 local ballot measures covering either restrictions on AI data centers or the removal of obstacles to their development, and voters rejected data‑center proposals in 40 of those 41 votes. A CNBC poll showed 56% of voters said data‑center issues were an important or decisive factor in how they voted.

Experts point to several possible reasons. First, with Democrats gaining control of Congress and winning key governorships, investors in certain tech sectors worry that data‑center development could face new limits, but Microsoft and Amazon investors may view a slowdown in data‑center construction as not necessarily negative.

Gina Hinojosa, the winning Democratic candidate for Texas governor, pledged during her campaign to halt any data‑center construction until the state adopts related regulations. The incumbent Republican governor, Greg Abbott, already paused the issuance of data‑center permits in September, but a report by watchdog FracTracker and Public Citizen found that permit processing continued after the order was issued.

Limited data‑center supply could actually benefit cloud giants by allowing price hikes. John Belton, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds, said the market expects computing power to remain in short supply, and “any additional restriction on data‑center capacity in the future” could let incumbents like Amazon and Microsoft raise prices.
He added that such a scenario could improve corporate profit margins and boost earnings potential.

Another view is that under the new policy environment, Microsoft and Amazon may slow their data‑center spending. As AI investment increasingly eats into the cash these companies generate, investors might welcome a cooling of capital expenditures.

Post‑election uncertainty fading fuels short covering. Ivan Feinseth, analyst at Tigress Financial Partners, noted that Microsoft and Amazon benefited from “post‑election relief, reduced policy uncertainty, renewed investor enthusiasm for AI and cloud computing, and large‑scale short covering.”
He explained that investors had been positioning defensively in anticipation of a post‑election market decline, but are now beginning to unwind those defensive positions.

Feinseth believes the election acted as a short‑term catalyst for tech stocks like Amazon and Microsoft, but that sustained AI demand and ongoing infrastructure spending – “more durable drivers” – will be the key long‑term forces shaping these stocks’ trajectories.

items.title: 民主黨勝選成漲勢催化劑！市場押注AI支出降速推升現金流　五大科技巨頭齊漲、市值單日暴增1兆美元
items.title_en: Democratic Party Victory Acts as a Rally Catalyst! Market Bets AI‑Spending Slowdown Boosts Cash Flow—All Five Tech Giants Rise, Market‑Cap Surges $1 Trillion in a Day
paras: 美國期中選舉結果牽動美國科技股走勢，五大科技巨頭週三(4日)股價集體跳漲，投資人押注民主黨掌控國會後，將放緩正瘋狂吞噬自由現金流的AI巨額支出，亞馬遜盤中一度大漲8.3%，微軟漲7%，Alphabet漲5.9%，Meta漲3.6%；連同避開AI重資產投入、一度漲逾6%的蘋果，五家巨頭合計市值料增近1兆美元。
民主黨在週二(3日)期中選舉中拿下參眾兩院多數，翻轉南卡羅來納、德州、堪薩斯等傳統共和黨票倉，並擴大州級執政版圖，其競選核心主張之一，正是審查AI資料中心大規模建設、強化地方監管。
Dakota Wealth資深投組經理人Robert Pavlik說，「市場反應就像在慶祝AI建設週期結束」，並稱若超大规模雲端業者不再砸千億建算力，自由現金流就有望由負轉正。
瑞銀策略報告亦引述出口民調指出，選民強烈反對社區新建資料中心，「藍色浪潮」最大衝擊將來自各州加強監管。
事實上，科技七巨頭近期持續承壓。自10月21日Meta揭開雲端財報季以來，彭博七巨頭指數已下跌5.9%，今年迄今漲幅減少至4.1%，落後標普500與那斯達克100。亞馬遜、Alphabet、Meta自由現金流均已轉負，資本支出靠發債與股權融資支撐。
分析師認為，週三行情雖帶投機色彩，卻點出關鍵轉變，也就是市場對自由現金流的敏感度已壓過AI敘事。雲端巨頭原本身處兩難，如今選舉像一份禮物，剎車由政府來踩。
paras_en: The results of the U.S. midterm elections are influencing the direction of American tech stocks. On Wednesday (the 4th), the shares of the five major tech giants all jumped, as investors bet that a Democratic‑controlled Congress will slow the massive AI spending that has been devouring free cash flow. Amazon surged as much as 8.3% intraday, Microsoft rose 7%, Alphabet 5.9%, Meta 3.6%, and even Apple—avoiding heavy AI‑related capital outlays—spiked more than 6%. Together, the five firms are expected to add nearly $1 trillion to their combined market value.

The Democrats captured majorities in both the House and Senate on Tuesday (the 3rd), flipping traditional Republican strongholds such as South Carolina, Texas and Kansas and expanding their state‑level governing footprint. One of their core campaign pledges is to scrutinize the large‑scale construction of AI data centers and tighten local regulation.

Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth, said, “The market’s reaction is like a celebration that the AI‑building cycle is ending,” adding that if the ultra‑large cloud providers stop pouring hundreds of billions into compute capacity, free cash flow could swing from negative to positive.

A UBS strategy report, citing an export poll, also noted that voters are strongly opposed to new community data centers, and that the biggest impact of the “blue wave” will come from tighter regulation at the state level.

In fact, the seven major tech firms have been under pressure lately. Since Meta kicked off the cloud earnings season on October 21, Bloomberg’s seven‑giant index has fallen 5.9%, and its year‑to‑date gain has shrunk to 4.1%, lagging both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq‑100. Amazon, Alphabet and Meta have all turned negative on free cash flow, with capital expenditures now being funded by debt and equity issuance.

Analysts say Wednesday’s market move, while speculative, highlights a key shift: sensitivity to free cash flow now outweighs the AI narrative. Cloud giants, previously caught in a dilemma, now see the election as a gift—braking power coming from the government.

items.title: 美國鋼價上漲美鋼獲利占日本製鐵比重估升破四成
items.title_en: U.S. Steel Prices Rise, U.S. Steel Profit Share in Nippon Steel Expected to Exceed 40%
paras: 2026年11月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國鋼價走高，正讓美國鋼鐵成為日本製鐵更重要的獲利來源。美鋼7至9月獲利預估將較去年同期增逾一倍，占日本製鐵當季獲利比重可望超過四成，高於前一季約三成。日本製鐵預定11月5日公布財報，上述數字仍屬公布前的預估。
這波獲利改善主要來自美國鋼市供需偏緊。關稅提高進口成本，AI資料中心興建則增加用鋼需求。依SteelBenchmarker資料，10月下旬美國熱軋鋼價較一年前上漲約五成，已高於日本製鐵先前估算獲利採用的鋼價假設，市場因而關注公司是否上調美鋼展望。
不過，海外成長尚未完全抵銷日本本業的壓力。日本製鐵原先預估，截至9月的上半年度，排除存貨評價影響的事業利益將年減28%；其中日本業務受需求疲弱、運輸與能源成本上升拖累，獲利估減六成，海外業務則估增71%。美鋼貢獻提高，反映的不只是美國市場轉強，也包括日本本業獲利收縮。
高鋼價也可能重新吸引進口貨源。依美國鋼鐵協會資料，美國9月鋼鐵進口量年增約五成至236萬噸，顯示部分進口鋼品即使加計關稅，仍開始具備價格競爭力。對日本製鐵而言，美國鋼價能否維持、進口回升速度，以及日本本業能否轉嫁成本，將共同影響這波海外獲利成長的延續性。

paras_en: November 5, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. steel prices are climbing, making U.S. steel a more important profit source for Nippon Steel. U.S. Steel’s profit for July‑September is projected to more than double year‑over‑year, and its share of Nippon Steel’s quarterly profit could exceed 40%, up from about 30% in the previous quarter. Nippon Steel plans to release its earnings on November 5, and the figures above are still pre‑release estimates.

The profit improvement stems mainly from a tighter U.S. steel market. Higher tariffs have raised import costs, while the construction of AI data centers has boosted steel demand. According to SteelBenchmarker data, U.S. hot‑rolled steel prices in late October are about 50% higher than a year ago, already above the price assumptions Nippon Steel used in its earlier profit forecasts, prompting the market to watch whether the company will raise its U.S. steel outlook.

However, overseas growth has not fully offset pressure on Nippon Steel’s domestic business. The company originally projected that, for the half‑year ending September and excluding inventory valuation effects, operating profit would decline 28% year‑on‑year; domestic operations were expected to see a 60% profit drop due to weak demand and higher transport and energy costs, while overseas operations were projected to grow 71%. The higher contribution from U.S. steel reflects not only a stronger U.S. market but also the contraction of Nippon Steel’s core domestic earnings.

Higher steel prices may also rekindle import sources. Data from the American Iron and Steel Institute show U.S. steel imports in September rose about 50% year‑over‑year to 2.36 million tonnes, indicating that some imported steel products remain price‑competitive even with tariffs. For Nippon Steel, whether U.S. steel prices can be sustained, the pace of import recovery, and the ability of its domestic business to pass on costs will together affect the durability of this overseas profit growth.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國民主黨大勝，引發美元下挫
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: U.S. Democratic Landslide Triggers Dollar Weakness
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國9月職位空缺大幅增加33.3萬達到752.3萬個，同時裁員人數減少12.7萬人至164.1萬人，為去年3月以來最低，顯示勞動力市場基礎仍穩固，並據美國總統川普對金融時報表示，美國目前沒有對伊朗發動打擊的計畫，但伊朗高級官員稱，與美國達成結束雙方戰爭的協議相去甚遠，引發油價劇烈震盪，而且投資者評估中東局勢及美國中期選舉結果，交投保持謹慎，週三推動美元兌日圓 自158.74高點下跌。隨著市場押注美國民主黨從川普總統領導的共和黨手中奪回國會控制權，但擔憂造成政治僵局及抑制政府支出，並將對人工智能(AI)行業監管趨嚴，拖累經濟增長，擴大美元兌日圓跌幅至157.39低點。

隨後信用評級機構Scope Ratings稱，民主黨在美國中期選舉全面獲勝，利好主權信用評級維持AA-及穩定展望，並據ADP全國就業報告顯示美國10月民間就業崗位增8.6萬個及美國商務部公布9月貿易逆差收窄至1,050億美元優於預期，而且標準普爾(S&P)全球調查美國10月綜合與服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)終值分別降至55.9及56.1，美國供應管理協會(ISM)數據亦顯示10月非製造業PMI跌至54.5，但高於50榮枯線及通貨膨脹高企，提振美元兌日圓。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.30-50，支撐於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD
昨日紐西蘭公布第三季失業率升至十一年新高5.7%及就業人數較前季降0.1%，引發紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)在12月加息的機率跌至57%，重創紐元，而且澳洲數據顯示9月家庭支出較前月增加0.6%高於前值及較上季持平0.7%，但10月經季節調整中國服務業PMI跌至三個月低點50.8，衝擊澳幣和其他風險貨幣，拖累歐元兌美元觸及1.1183低點。

items.title: 共和黨敗選後首波政治清算！赫格塞斯成美伊戰爭「替罪羔羊」 CNN：最快下周啟動彈劾投票
items.title_en: First Wave of Political Payback After GOP Election Loss! Hegseth Becomes the “Scapegoat” of the US‑Iran War, CNN: Impeachment Vote Could Start as Early as Next Week
paras: 美國期中選舉民主黨橫掃參眾兩院，共和黨內迅速掀起問責風暴，矛頭直指國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)，最新傳出多位共和黨議員與盟友將敗選歸咎於伊朗戰爭，認為赫格塞斯是推動開戰的關鍵人物，卻未規劃退場機制與政治後果管理。
《CNN》報導，肯塔基州共和黨籍眾議員Thomas Massie在眾議院復會後，將發起彈劾赫格塞思的投票，指控其未經國會授權對伊朗採取敵對行動、濫用職權。共和黨消息人士預期表決可過關，這將是現屆國會選後首波政治清算。
美國總統川普週三(4日)則公開力挺赫格塞斯，稱其「幹得非常好」、無意撤換，但顧問私下坦言，戰爭拖累選情下，「總得有人承擔責任，而不會是總統」。
美國副總統萬斯亦鬆口質疑伊朗戰事是否值得，共和黨參議員Thom Tillis直言赫格塞斯終將面臨「清算」，其與國會交惡更恐拖累1.5兆美元國防支出案。
民主黨已承諾展開廣泛調查，涵蓋伊朗軍事行動決策、高階將領「清洗」、烏克蘭政策，以及拉美海域疑似涉戰爭罪的反毒空襲。
另有傳聞稱，赫格塞斯可能轉任田納西州參議員，接替明年出任州長的Marsha Blackburn遺缺，川普僅稱「沒聽說過這種說法」。
分析指出，2006年小布希以倫斯斐為伊拉克戰爭背書的下課劇本正被重提。赫格塞思雖暫保官位，卻同時承受白宮止損、黨內倒戈、國會調查三重壓力，這場「替罪羔羊」博弈，將決定川普政府剩餘任期的國防路線與戰爭責任歸屬。
paras_en: The Democrats swept both houses of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, prompting an immediate accountability storm within the Republican Party that zeroes in on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Multiple GOP lawmakers and allies are blaming the loss on the war with Iran, arguing that Hegseth was the key figure who pushed the country into conflict without a clear exit strategy or political fallout management plan.

CNN reports that Republican Representative Thomas Massie of Kentucky will launch an impeachment vote against Hegseth after the House reconvenes, accusing him of taking hostile action against Iran without congressional authorization and abusing his authority. Republican sources expect the vote to pass, marking the first wave of political payback in the current Congress after the election.

President Donald Trump publicly backed Hegseth on Wednesday (the 4th), calling his performance “very good” and saying there is no intention to replace him. However, advisers privately admitted that the war is hurting the administration’s electoral prospects and that “someone has to take responsibility, and it won’t be the president.”

Vice President Kamala Harris also hinted that the Iran war may not be worth it, while Republican Senator Thom Tillis bluntly said Hegseth will eventually face “payback,” warning that his clash with Congress could jeopardize a $1.5 trillion defense spending bill.

Democrats have pledged a broad investigation covering the decision‑making behind Iran’s military actions, a “purge” of senior officers, Ukraine policy, and alleged war‑crime‑related anti‑drug airstrikes in Latin American waters.

There are rumors that Hegseth could be appointed to the U.S. Senate from Tennessee to fill the seat that will be vacated by Governor‑elect Marsha Blackburn next year; Trump said he “has never heard of such a suggestion.”

Analysts note that the script used in 2006 when George W. Bush backed the Iraq war with the Lunsford‑type resignation is being revisited. While Hegseth currently retains his post, he is simultaneously under pressure from the White House to cut losses, from his party’s internal revolt, and from congressional investigations. This “scapegoat” showdown will determine the defense trajectory and war‑responsibility allocation for the remainder of the Trump administration’s term.

paras: 美元對主要貨幣周三(4日)走軟，民主黨在美國期中選舉大獲全勝，拿下參眾兩院，掃除市場原本可能因選舉爭議所面臨的巨大不確定性，投資人同時也在權衡監管政策改變的可能性。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)下跌0.25%，報101.60，盤中稍早曾跌至101.21，創9月30日以來最低。
歐元兌美元升值0.21%至1.1217美元，稍早曾升至1.1272美元，是10月6日以來最高。
民主黨掌控美國參議院與眾議院，在部分共和黨傳統票倉取得數十年來首見的壓倒性勝利，數千萬選民以選票嚴厲譴責總統川普。
這場大勝緩解了外界對選舉結果可能引發爭議的疑慮，但也讓美國面臨分裂政府與立法僵局的可能性：共和黨掌控白宮，民主黨則掌控國會，時間正值美國設法因應伊朗戰爭，以及同時推動經濟成長、加劇通膨的人工智慧(AI)熱潮。
美股周三應聲上漲，標普500指數上漲約2%。投資人等待華府對美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭的下一步行動之際，原油價格則大幅下挫。
多倫多貴金屬交易商Silver Gold Bull外匯與貴金屬風險管理主管Erik Bregar說：「市場瀰漫風險偏好情緒。或許我們看到的是一種『利多出盡後賣出、事實明朗後買進』的組合，也就是市場對選舉結果不會因舞弊爭議而陷入僵局感到寬慰。」
他說：「從基本面來看，民主黨對資料中心等議題的立場，仍可能讓市場對AI產生更多疑慮。但就目前而言，市場鬆了一口氣，因為川普不會對選舉結果提出抗爭。當各類資產普遍呈現風險偏好情緒時，通常會對美元造成壓力。」
儘管美國政局出現變化，市場對聯準會(Fed)利率走向的預期大致維持不變。根據芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具，市場目前預估，Fed 12月會議升息至少1碼的機率為81.2%，高於前一交易日的77.4%。

就業數據優於預期

ADP全美私人企業就業報告顯示，美國民間企業10月新增8.6萬個工作機會，高於經濟學家預估的6.9萬個。這是本周陸續公布的一系列勞動市場數據之一，重頭戲將是周五由美國政府公布的非農就業報告。
美國供應管理協會(ISM)另一份報告則顯示，10月非製造業指數從9月的54.9降至54.5。最新數值略低於經濟學家預估的54.8，但仍高於代表景氣擴張的50榮枯線。

這是英鎊連續第六個交易日升值，將是自7月6日結束連八日漲勢以來最長的連漲紀錄。
市場預期，英國央行將因能源成本飆升帶來的通膨壓力而升息，但可能反駁投資人對明年還會有數次升息的押注。

paras_en: The dollar weakened against major currencies on Wednesday (the 4th) as the Democratic Party achieved a sweeping victory in the U.S. midterm elections, taking control of both the Senate and the House and eliminating the huge uncertainty that markets had faced over possible election disputes. Investors are also weighing the likelihood of regulatory policy changes.

In the New York close, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.25% to 101.60 after dipping earlier in the session to 101.21, its lowest level since September 30.
The euro rose 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1217, having earlier peaked at $1.1272, the highest since October 6.

The Democrats now control the U.S. Senate and House, winning an overwhelming victory in several traditional Republican strongholds for the first time in decades, with tens of millions of voters harshly rebuking President Trump at the ballot box.

The landslide eases concerns that the election outcome could spark disputes, but it also raises the prospect of a divided government and legislative gridlock: Republicans hold the White House while Democrats control Congress, at a time when the U.S. must respond to the Iran war and simultaneously drive economic growth amid an AI-fueled inflation surge.
U.S. equities rose on Wednesday, with the S&P 500 up about 2%. While investors await Washington’s next steps on the Iran conflict involving the United States and Israel, oil prices fell sharply.

Erik Bregar, head of FX and precious‑metal risk management at Toronto‑based Silver Gold Bull, said, “The market is awash with risk‑on sentiment. Perhaps we are seeing a ‘sell after the news is fully priced in, buy once the facts are clear’ mix, meaning the market is relieved that the election result will not be mired in fraud disputes.”

He added, “From a fundamentals view, the Democrats’ stance on data‑center issues and the like could still raise more AI‑related concerns. But for now the market has breathed a sigh of relief because Trump is unlikely to contest the result. When assets broadly show risk‑on sentiment, the dollar usually comes under pressure.”

Despite the political shift, expectations for the Federal Reserve’s rate path remain largely unchanged. According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, the market now sees an 81.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least one basis point at the December meeting, up from 77.4% the previous trading day.

Employment data beat expectations. The ADP National Employment Report showed private‑sector employers added 86,000 jobs in October, above economists’ forecast of 69,000. This is one of several labor‑market releases this week, with the headline non‑farm payroll report due from the U.S. government on Friday.

A separate ISM report showed the October non‑manufacturing index fell to 54.5 from September’s 54.9. The reading was slightly below the 54.8 forecast but remained well above the 50‑point threshold that signals expansion.
Ahead of the Bank of England’s (BOE) Thursday rate decision, the pound rose 0.38% to $1.3462, briefly reaching $1.3503 intraday – a seven‑week high.
This marks the pound’s sixth consecutive trading‑day gain, the longest streak since the eight‑day rally that ended on July 6.
Markets expect the BOE to raise rates in response to inflation pressure from soaring energy costs, though this may counter investors’ bets on multiple hikes next year.
The dollar slipped 0.14% against the yen, trading at ¥158.43.
